comptaclems.title: ComptaClems — accounting management platform
comptaclems.summary: Independent web platform project to centralize client, document, and file management for an accounting services firm.
comptaclems.description: ComptaClems structures three spaces — public, client, admin — to reduce manual email exchanges and give clear tracking of accounting files, tax filings, and administrative requests.
challenge: Centralize exchanges currently scattered across email and paper documents.
Clearly separate the client space from the administrator space.
Design a data structure suited to real accounting services (bookkeeping, GST/QST, payroll).
approach: Mapped accounting services before designing the screens.
Strict role separation: public, authenticated client, administrator.
PostgreSQL database designed around files, documents, and processing statuses.
limitations: In active development: several planned features are still being built.
No accounting firm is using the platform in production yet.
Security and compliance still need validation before handling real tax data.

seo.title: ComptaClems — accounting management platform
seo.description: Independent web platform project for accounting firms to manage clients, documents, and tax filings.

bilikFarm.title: Bilik Farm — farm website and CRM
bilikFarm.summary: Public website and internal CRM for an integrated farm combining crop and livestock operations.
bilikFarm.description: Bilik Farm pairs a public showcase of the farm (activities, products, vision) with an internal CRM to track crops, animals, sales, inventory, and clients.
challenge: Present a farm with multiple activities (crops and livestock) clearly.
Bring sales, inventory, and client tracking into a single tool.
Separate the public showcase from internal operational management.
approach: Public site kept separate from the CRM, with authentication for the internal space.
Dashboard focused on tracking crops, animals, and sales.
Modular Next.js architecture to add management modules progressively.
limitations: Independent project: no farm currently uses it in production.
Internal reports and indicators still need validation with real usage.
No real sales or profitability data integrated.

seo.title: Bilik Farm — farm website and CRM
seo.description: Independent showcase website and CRM project for an integrated crop and livestock farm.

cosmechic.title: Cosmechic — e-commerce store
cosmechic.summary: Online store dedicated to cosmetic products for Black, mixed-heritage, and Afro skin and hair.
cosmechic.description: Cosmechic presents a cosmetics catalog and order/client management, with a mobile-first interface built for this specific market.
challenge: Structure a catalog by category and care type.
Keep the purchase journey simple on mobile.
Plan for order and inventory management on the admin side.
approach: Catalog and product pages organized by need (skin, hair, routine).
Cart-to-checkout flow designed for mostly mobile usage.
Separate admin space for order and catalog tracking.
limitations: Independent project, not yet operating as a commercial store.
Online payment and real logistics not deployed in production.
No real sales volume or clients.

seo.title: Cosmechic — e-commerce store
seo.description: Independent e-commerce store project for cosmetic products for Afro skin and hair.

biketrip.title: BikeTrip — mobile app for cyclists
biketrip.summary: React Native mobile app to plan bike rides: routes, weather, safety, and ride tracking.
biketrip.description: BikeTrip helps cyclists discover routes, track their rides, and share community reports, with a Supabase backend and automated test coverage.
challenge: Bring route discovery, weather, and safety into a single app.
Ensure reliable ride data (distance, speed, elevation).
Secure user data with strict access rules.
approach: React Native + Expo architecture with file-based routing.
Supabase backend with Row Level Security (RLS) for data isolation.
Unit test suite (Jest) and GitHub Actions continuous integration.
limitations: GPS statistics not yet validated on a physical device under real conditions.
Offline mode and background GPS tracking not yet delivered.
App not yet published on app stores (EAS Build still pending).

seo.title: BikeTrip — mobile app for cyclists
seo.description: Independent React Native mobile app project to plan and track bike rides.

eduquiz.title: EduQuiz — bilingual education platform
eduquiz.summary: Bilingual FR/EN education platform for Quebec students from grade 3 to grade 11, built as a Next.js monorepo.
eduquiz.description: EduQuiz aims to help students learn, review, and practice their lessons with quizzes adapted to their level, on a complete technical foundation (monorepo, authentication, Quebec privacy-law compliance).
challenge: Build a bilingual showcase covering 10 subjects and 9 grade levels.
Secure authentication and data for underage students.
Plan for compliance from the start (data export, account deletion).
approach: Turborepo/pnpm monorepo with shared packages (UI, database, auth, i18n).
Auth.js authentication with Argon2id hashing and Redis rate limiting.
Audit logging and health checks for application reliability.
limitations: Quiz engine and learning progression not yet delivered.
Parent dashboard and full minor-user flow not complete.
Actively in development; phase 1 partially delivered.

seo.title: EduQuiz — bilingual education platform
seo.description: Independent bilingual education platform project for Quebec students, built as a Next.js monorepo.

forumSportif.title: Forum Sportif — geolocated community platform
forumSportif.summary: Community forum to find sports venues by geolocation and connect with other enthusiasts.
forumSportif.description: Forum Sportif combines a discussion forum, location search by sport, and an interactive map to help people discover fields, gyms, clubs, and sports spaces nearby.
challenge: Combine geolocated search and community discussion in one product.
Structure sports categories and user profiles.
Allow reviews and reports on listed venues.
approach: Interactive map paired with search by sport and area.
Forum organized by sports categories with posts and comments.
User profiles and a venue review system.
limitations: Independent project, no active community deployed yet.
Moderation and reviews need a framework before real public use.
Geographic coverage and venue data not field-validated.

seo.title: Forum Sportif — geolocated community platform
seo.description: Independent geolocated sports forum project to find venues and connect with other enthusiasts.
